thesis: Find businesses whose value increases, rather than merely whose labour cost falls, as machine intelligence becomes abundant.
decision: Choose, validate, and sequence UK business opportunities by combining commercial evidence with an explicit analysis of AI substitution, interface change, operating leverage, and durable real-world advantages.

aiDimensions.label: AI substitution risk
aiDimensions.question: How much of the customer's desired outcome can a model or agent produce without this business?

aiDimensions.label: Generated-content supply
aiDimensions.question: How does cheap synthetic text, imagery, audio, or video change supply, trust, discovery costs, and the value of original evidence?

aiDimensions.label: Discovery disruption
aiDimensions.question: Can AI answers, recommendations, or summaries remove the visit, enquiry, or comparison step the business currently monetises?

aiDimensions.label: Agent bypass risk
aiDimensions.question: Can a purchasing or scheduling agent transact directly with suppliers and route around the proposed intermediary?

aiDimensions.label: AI operating leverage
aiDimensions.question: Which bounded workflows become faster, cheaper, or more reliable, and who retains the resulting margin?

aiDimensions.label: Proprietary data potential
aiDimensions.question: Does operating the business create verified data unavailable from public sources or generic model training?

aiDimensions.label: Physical-world moat
aiDimensions.question: Which parts depend on premises, equipment, logistics, inspection, attendance, or local delivery?

aiDimensions.label: Trust and liability moat
aiDimensions.question: Where do credentials, accountability, insurance, safety, or legal liability constrain automated substitution?

aiDimensions.label: Relationship moat
aiDimensions.question: How much value sits in repeat customers, suppliers, venues, dealers, buyers, or other relationships that an answer interface does not own?

aiDimensions.label: Platform dependency
aiDimensions.question: How exposed is the model to search engines, marketplaces, feeds, model providers, or a single acquisition channel?

aiDimensions.label: Defensibility in 2028
aiDimensions.question: After plausible adoption by customers and incumbents, what scarce asset or capability remains?

gates.exitCriterion: The decision unit, buyer, geography, time horizon, counterfactual, exclusions, and stopping rule are explicit.
The present value chain, demand, supply, economics, regulation, and evidence gaps are mapped without AI assumptions.
Every material AI impact has an actor, mechanism, time horizon, evidence class, countervailing force, and observable indicator.
Conservative, base, and upside cases show who captures savings or new revenue and what changes under agent bypass.
The strongest disconfirming evidence, incumbent response, failure modes, and kill conditions have been tested.
The paper makes a clear build, test, defer, acquire, or reject decision and identifies the next reversible action.
Artifacts parse, calculations reconcile, consequential links are checked, secrets are absent, and unknowns remain visible.

existingSeriesRetrofits.title: AI disruption in UK rank-and-rent and local lead generation
existingSeriesRetrofits.decision: Test whether the local-demand thesis survives AI answers, generated-content abundance, lead agents, platform encroachment, and commoditised operator tooling.
humanSeams: First-party query and conversion cohorts across classic and generative search
Buyer interviews and controlled acquisition tests

existingSeriesRetrofits.title: AI disruption in product aggregation
existingSeriesRetrofits.decision: Test whether a decision-led product business retains value when shopping agents can compare merchant feeds and generated content makes generic buying guides abundant.
humanSeams: First-party agent-referred conversion and attribution cohorts

existingSeriesRetrofits.title: AI disruption in the social events economy
existingSeriesRetrofits.decision: Test whether physical social programming becomes more or less valuable as event content becomes cheap to generate, organisers gain similar AI tools, and synthetic companionship competes for attention.
humanSeams: Attendee, non-returner, venue, and host fieldwork
Observed ticket, attendance, repeat, and contribution cohorts

workstreams.title: The UK Commercial-Premises Compliance Economy
workstreams.workingSubtitle: What must be done, what must be bought, and what AI can actually change
workstreams.decision: Determine whether a defensible business should generate demand, manage compliance workflows, partner with accredited providers, acquire an operator, or remain out of the category.
autonomousScope: Map obligations by jurisdiction and distinguish required activity from required third-party spend
Compare provider supply, credentials, public pricing, filed-company evidence, and software incumbents
Model one-off, event-triggered, and recurring service economics
Test AI-assisted administration, evidence review, triage, and reporting against liability and competence boundaries
humanSeams: Any live acquisition or paid-demand test
workstreams.stopCondition: Stop or narrow the thesis if external paid provision is not structurally necessary, credible providers cannot retain attractive contribution after acquisition cost, or liability cannot be bounded without owning regulated delivery.

workstreams.title: The Regional City Opportunity Atlas
workstreams.workingSubtitle: Where physical social infrastructure remains valuable as digital companionship improves
workstreams.decision: Choose one UK city or compact urban cluster, initial audience, venue pattern, and six-week programme for an interest-led social-events pilot.
autonomousScope: Build a consistent city scorecard covering reachable audience, participation, supply, transport, venue economics, competition, and repeat-density potential
Separate social-need evidence from willingness to pay
Compare AI-assisted programming, discovery, matching, and follow-up with the irreducible work of hosting and city liquidity
Produce a launch recommendation with sensitivity and kill conditions
humanSeams: Attendee, venue, host, and non-returner interviews
Ticket sales or paid acquisition tests
workstreams.stopCondition: Do not recommend a city unless it has a plausible reachable cohort, workable venue and transport pattern, evidence of paid participation, and a path to repeated rather than one-off attendance.

workstreams.title: Vertical Marketplaces After Shopping Agents
workstreams.workingSubtitle: Specialist equipment, private inventory, inspection, finance, and fulfilment
workstreams.decision: Determine whether small plant and smallholding equipment can support a marketplace whose inventory, verification, and transaction services remain useful when agents can compare public listings directly.
autonomousScope: Map new, used, private, dealer, auction, hire, finance, inspection, transport, and servicing purchase paths
Measure public inventory liquidity without treating duplicated listings as independent supply
Identify which data and transaction services a shopping agent cannot reproduce from public pages
Model listing, subscription, lead, finance-referral, inspection, and transaction revenue
humanSeams: Finance, inspection, warranty, or transport partnerships
workstreams.stopCondition: Reject the marketplace thesis if public listing aggregation is the principal value, dealer supply is too concentrated, or agents can access equivalent inventory and services without the proposed operator.

workstreams.title: Buying Boring Businesses in an AI Economy
workstreams.workingSubtitle: When to generate demand, partner, build delivery, or acquire the fulfilment layer
workstreams.decision: Establish which small UK operating businesses become materially more valuable under bounded AI-enabled process improvements and whether acquisition outperforms greenfield entry.
autonomousScope: Compare lead sale, revenue share, joint venture, greenfield delivery, asset purchase, and share purchase
Build operating-improvement cases for quoting, scheduling, routing, reporting, renewal, and customer communication
Distinguish broker asking prices, filed financial evidence, and completed transaction evidence
Model owner dependence, credential continuity, customer concentration, working capital, and downside cases
humanSeams: Proprietor, broker, lender, and acquisition interviews
Legal, tax, financing, and regulated-industry advice
workstreams.stopCondition: Do not recommend acquisition where improvement depends mainly on replacing trusted staff, where credentials or customer relationships do not transfer, or where the valuation assumes unverified AI savings.

workstreams.title: From Public Records to Proprietary Intelligence
workstreams.workingSubtitle: Building a commercial-signals business after generic research becomes abundant
workstreams.decision: Determine whether monitored, source-linked commercial evidence can support a subscription or workflow product without misrepresenting registry activity as trading quality or buying intent.
autonomousScope: Compare public-record summaries with monitored identity resolution, change detection, lineage, and verified outcome data
Map buyer workflows where timeliness and auditability matter more than generated prose
Evaluate subscription, alerting, dataset, evidence-pack, and analyst-assisted revenue
Define privacy, provenance, correction, and confidence controls
humanSeams: Access to customer workflow or outcome data
Sales, outreach, CRM changes, or subscription launch
workstreams.stopCondition: Reject any proposition whose output is reproducible from one public source and a generic model, or whose value depends on inferring intent from registry evidence.

workstreams.title: Commercial Discovery After Generative Search
workstreams.workingSubtitle: Observed visibility, visits, actions, and revenue across real properties
workstreams.decision: Measure which original evidence, tools, transactional pages, and local utilities continue to earn commercially valuable discovery through classic and generative search.
inputs: At least one operating property with sufficient Search Console and conversion history
workstreams.blockedReason: No qualifying first-party property history is currently available in this repository.
autonomousScope: Define the measurement design and comparable page cohorts
Analyse consented first-party Search Console and conversion exports once supplied
Separate visibility, visits, assisted actions, direct transactions, and revenue
Compare original evidence and tools with commodity informational content
humanSeams: Confirm the relevant conversion and revenue definitions
workstreams.stopCondition: Do not replace missing first-party performance with third-party traffic estimates or platform anecdotes.
